purpose: Teach: 対人/竹下/地主/産ん/取り出す/昌/キツイ/岬

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「対人スキルを磨いておくと得だよ」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying it's worth building up your people skills.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Relaying something Ryosuke said with gentle approval. Light, unhurried pace. The tone of a mother sharing something she noticed he valued.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「竹下首相時代の話を伝えたい」って仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad was telling me about when Takeshita was Prime Minister.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share something new he learned. Slight wonder in the voice — genuinely interested in what he picked up. Natural, unforced enthusiasm. No performance, just engagement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「地主だったご親戚のお話を語って下さるわ」
lines.en: Sho — your dad was telling me some stories about relatives who were landlords.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective cadence. Passing along a family story with quiet reverence. Slow, measured delivery. The voice of someone listening to history being kept alive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「ぼくを産んで下さって有り難い」って仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad said he's grateful you were born.
lines.style: Small, sincere voice. The weight of that gratitude landing softly. Pause before delivery — this matters. Steady eye-contact level. No embellishment, just the honest thing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが冷蔵庫からチーズを取り出すのを手伝って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad helped me get cheese out of the fridge.
lines.style: Simple statement, matter-of-fact warmth. The small comfortable moment of being helped by Dad. Natural rhythm — not performed, just reporting something that happened and mattered.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「昌雄おじいちゃん」のお墓参り行ったよ
lines.en: Mom — I went to visit Grandpa Masao's grave with Dad.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. The specific naming of a person gone. Steady, respectful pace. The voice of a child marking something he did that felt important, without needing to explain why.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「最近の仕事はキツイ」って漏らされたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying work has been really tough lately.
lines.style: Lower register, more careful. The sound of overhearing something Ryosuke let slip. Gentle concern underneath — not worried, but noticing. Soft, as if not wanting to broadcast it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと房総半島の岬で日の出観たよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad and I watched the sunrise from a cape out in Boso Peninsula.
lines.style: Brightening at the memory. The image carrying quiet beauty — not overselling it, just letting it land. Open, present delivery. The joy of being there with someone, held in the voice.
